meta.name: bioservices
meta.description: Unified Python interface to 40+ bioinformatics services. Use when querying multiple databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome) in a single workflow with consistent API. Best for cross-database analysis, ID mapping across services. For quick single-database lookups use gget; for sequence/file manipulation use biopython.

howto.what: 装好后 Claude 会用 Python 调 40 多个生物信息学数据库的接口,帮你在同一个流程里查生物数据、转换跨库 ID、跑 BLAST 等。
howto.when: 当你要求一次性查询多个生物数据库(如 UniProt、KEGG、ChEMBL 等),或需要跨数据库做 ID 转换、通路分析时触发。

say.text: 帮我查蛋白 P43403 的 FASTA 序列,并映射到 KEGG 数据库。
say.note: 会调用 UniProt 的检索与 ID 映射。

say.text: 用 KEGG 找人类中与 T 细胞相关的通路。
say.note: 会查 pathway 并把结果解析成结构化数据。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the BioServices Python package to query 40+ bioinformatics web services, retrieve biological data, map identifiers across databases, and run BLAST in one workflow.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to query multiple bio databases (e.g., UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL) in one workflow, or to map IDs / analyze pathways across services, rather than quick single-database lookups.

say_en.text: Look up FASTA sequence for protein P43403 and map its ID to KEGG.
say_en.note: Uses UniProt search and ID mapping.

say_en.text: Use KEGG to find human pathways related to T cells.
say_en.note: Fetches pathway data and parses it.

say_en.text: Convert the KEGG ID for Geldanamycin into a ChEMBL ID.
